classification: Test synchronization hardening; no product defect established by observed failure or isolated rerun.

originalObservedFailure.name: recovers a normalized sketch without counting hydration as an edit or automatically saving it
originalObservedFailure.assertion: expected saved x:1 to contain restored x:99

diagnosis: The mock exposes onChange during render, but sends its initial x:1 scene in a passive effect. The test waits only for placeholder DOM. An edit delivered before mock hydration can establish x:99 as baseline and make delayed x:1 hydration the stored edit. This is a source-supported ordering risk; the isolated unchanged run did not reproduce the fullsuite failure.
fix: Explicit hydration flag set only after initial onChange, reset on unmount and before tests; await hydration on both mounts; assert clean hydration and exact retained x:99 scene before unmount; preserve restore and no-autosave assertions.
remainingGates: No fullsuite rerun; historical fullsuite remains 2938 passed, 2 failed, and interrupted without completed runner receipt.
Real native adapter, browser journey and product completion gates were not evaluated by this narrow mock test.
